description.value: Diba is a Persian restaurant in Vancouver's West End, a short ride from the Stanley Park Seawall, serving traditional kebabs, stews, and vegetarian dishes in a no-smoking indoor and outdoor setting. The menu spans Iranian classics from ghormeh sabzi and fesenjoon to a dedicated vegetarian section and shareable kebab platters. Online ordering is available directly through Uber Eats and DoorDash for cyclists needing a quick pickup.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 52m; stands (6 spaces) at 54m. Total: 8 spaces.
